mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_user ( userCode, userName, userPassword, gender, birthday, email, phone, address, userDesc, userRole, imgPath, status, registerReason, createdBy, creationDate ) VALUES ( #{userCode}, #{userName}, #{userPassword}, #{gender}, #{birthday}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{userDesc}, #{userRole}, #{imgPath}, #{status}, #{registerReason}, #{createdBy}, #{creationDate} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, userCode, userName, userPassword, gender, birthday, email, phone, address, userDesc, userRole, imgPath, status, registerReason, createdBy, creationDate, modifyBy, modifyDate FROM tb_user WHERE userCode = #{userCode}

SELECT id, userCode, userName, userPassword, gender, birthday, email, phone, address, userDesc, userRole, imgPath, status, registerReason, createdBy, creationDate, modifyBy, modifyDate FROM tb_user WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_user SET status = #{status}, modifyDate = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, userCode, userName, userPassword, gender, birthday, email, phone, address, userDesc, userRole, imgPath, status, registerReason, createdBy, creationDate, modifyBy, modifyDate FROM tb_user WHERE status IS NULL OR status = 0 OR status = 3 ORDER BY creationDate DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_user WHERE status IS NULL OR status = 0 OR status = 3
